prerequisites: Good knowledge of classic naive algorithms

learning_outcomes.text: To be able to relate a problem to a class of problems, deduce an appropriate approach for its resolution, validate the correctness of the proposed solution, and analyze its complexity.

syllabus_topics: Informal but rigorous reasoning linking the realization of an algorithm to its specifications, refinement of an algorithm scheme towards a particular realization
Classic resolution methods whose main criterion is complexity (greedy algorithms, divide and conquer, dynamic programming...)
Classic problem types (graph traversal, enumeration of a set of candidates...), and how the expression of a solution (iterative, recursive) is linked to the underlying structure
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Informatique (UGA)
